selection_independence: Holdouts were retrieved by historical meaning/domain from published Steffel examples and then checked in the pinned modern lexicon; positive, negative, and unresolved outcomes are retained.

patterns.interpretation: Strong documentary recurrence in the participial/derivational domain; not automatic morphological identity or cognacy.

patterns.specific_modern_phonemic_holdout: Caballero 2022 tʃaˈpí 'grab' corresponding semantically to historical tschapí 'agarrar' and modern Chapí RD-000656
patterns.interpretation: The multi-family graphic recurrence is externally compatible with published historical and modern phonetic analyses. Historical initial <tsch>/<ts> free variation before a parallels modern optional /tʃ/→[ts] before low central vowels. Rule identity and historical persistence are not adjudicated.

patterns.published_historical_phonetic_interpreta: Merrill et al. 2020 treats intervocalic <ss> as voiceless [s], not phonological gemination.
patterns.interpretation: Do not analyze this as deletion of one s; test historical [s] against modern /s/ with variety control.
Observed in Cotſchimé~Cochí but also in semantically contradictory Bajé~Bají; cannot discriminate continuity.

source_supported_interpretation.steffel_tsch: Merrill et al. 2020 §7.5.2 associates <tsch> with a voiceless palatoalveolar affricate [č] and analyzes <tsch>/<ts> as allophones of /č/; Appendix 5 transcribes tschapí as čapí and other <tsch> forms systematically with č.
source_supported_interpretation.steffel_ss: Merrill et al. 2020 §7.5.5 interprets intervocalic <ss> as voiceless [s], not phonological gemination.
source_supported_interpretation.modern_choguita: Caballero 2022 includes phonemic /tʃ/ and /s/, optional /tʃ/→[ts] depalatalization before low central vowels, and independently documents tʃaˈpí 'grab'.
source_supported_interpretation.structural_parallel: Historical initial <tsch>/<ts> free variation before a and modern optional /tʃ/→[ts] before low central vowels constitute a source-supported allophonic structural parallel, not proof that one historical conditioning rule persisted unchanged.
source_supported_interpretation.variety_caution: Choguita Rarámuri and the pinned SRC-02 lexicon are independent modern sources/varieties and are not collapsed into one variety.
